name: Indaiatuba

queries.query: Indaiatuba Brazil official cadastral map parcel cadastro imobiliário map Prefeitura
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Prefeitura Municipal de Indaiatuba engineering portal, its Department of Cadastro de Imóveis e Edificações, Geoprocessamento and Cartografia e Topografia pages, municipal/thematic map pages, and public cadastral consultation routes. No public parcel geometry API was identified in the official pages.

queries.query: Indaiatuba mapa cadastral oficial cadastro imobiliário parcelas Prefeitura geoprocessamento
queries.result: A busca em português confirmou a municipalidade as local custodian: Departamento de Cadastro de Imóveis e Edificações, Departamento de Geoprocessamento and Cartografia e Topografia. The municipality publishes maps and loteamento plans and offers Consulta Número de Cadastro, but the public query is protected by hCaptcha and no anonymous parcel geometry service was exposed.

registryCustodian.name: Prefeitura Municipal de Indaiatuba, Secretaria Municipal de Planejamento Urbano e Engenharia; Departamento de Cadastro de Imóveis e Edificações / Departamento de Geoprocessamento
registryCustodian.scope: Municipal cadastral and geoprocessing custodian. Official pages describe cadastral-imovel services and municipal mapping, but do not establish an anonymous parcel geometry API or unrestricted bulk download.

service.name: Indaiatuba municipal Consulta Número de Cadastro / municipal map portal
service.viewerConfiguration: Official HTML was fetched and inspected. The cadastro consultation is an HTML POST form with address or loteamento/quadra/lote inputs and an hCaptcha site key. Official map pages link to municipal map documents and loteamento plan downloads; no current JavaScript map configuration or public OGC/ArcGIS parcel endpoint was exposed.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Official municipal department page fetched; it establishes the local cadastro-imobiliário custodian and links to cadastral procedures. No parcel API endpoint was exposed.
Official geoprocessing page fetched; it identifies municipal geoprocessing and cartography contacts but exposes no public parcel service URL.
Official municipal maps page fetched; map documents are offered, but no parcel polygon API or safe parcel identity schema was exposed.
Official loteamentos page fetched; it lists downloadable subdivision plans. These are plan documents rather than a verified citywide parcel API, so no polygon was retained.
Official cadastral-number consultation form fetched. The form supports address and loteamento/quadra/lote searches but requires hCaptcha; no CAPTCHA was solved or bypassed, and no POST was submitted.
Official municipal citizen portal fetched; property features are presented behind gov.br authentication. No login or authenticated/private request was attempted.
